# NAVNA — Digital Growth Agency

> NAVNA is a digital growth agency that helps businesses build and grow their online presence through website design & development, Google Business Profile optimization, SEO, Meta Ads, and social media management.

## About NAVNA

NAVNA is a digital growth agency founded by Chiranjivi Sah and Taha. The agency helps businesses establish, improve, and manage their digital presence. NAVNA provides practical, honest digital solutions — no jargon, no inflated promises.

Website: https://navna.online
Contact: https://navna.online/contact

### Founders

- **Chiranjivi Sah** — Co-Founder. Focused on full-stack web development, web design, and local SEO. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/chiranjivi-sah/
- **Taha** — Co-Founder. Focused on SEO & search visibility, Meta Ads management, and social media management. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mohammad-taha11/

## Services

NAVNA offers five core digital growth services:

### 1. Website Design & Development
Design and develop fast, responsive, professional websites that clearly present your business and turn visitors into customers. Built with Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS.
URL: https://navna.online/services/web-design-development

### 2. Google Business Profile Optimization
Help businesses improve their Google Business Profile, local presence, and visibility when customers search nearby on Google Maps and Google Search.
URL: https://navna.online/services/google-business-profile

### 3. SEO & Search Visibility
Improve how your business is discovered through search engines with technically sound SEO, indexing, and on-page optimization.
URL: https://navna.online/services/seo

### 4. Meta Ads Management
Create and manage Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns designed to help businesses reach relevant audiences and generate enquiries.
URL: https://navna.online/services/meta-ads

### 5. Social Media Management
Help businesses maintain a consistent and professional presence across their social media platforms through content planning and profile management.
URL: https://navna.online/services/social-media-management

## How NAVNA Works

1. **Discovery** — Understand the business, goals, and current digital presence
2. **Strategy** — Identify the right digital priorities and plan the approach
3. **Execution** — Design, develop, and implement the agreed solutions
4. **Launch** — Deploy and go live with quality assurance
5. **Growth** — Ongoing optimization, management, and improvement
